rules.condition: trackId is present, at most 255 characters and matches ^track\.[a-z0-9]+(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$
totalDigits is exactly six ASCII digits (M SS mmm)
the seconds digits (positions 2-3) are at most 59
coin changes or mushrooms are only entered when lap times are entered
when any lap time is entered, the number of lap rows equals context.trackLapCount (3, or 7)
when any lap time is entered, every lap time is entered (all or none)
an entered lap time is exactly six ASCII digits
the lap's seconds digits are at most 59
the lap times add up exactly to the total (evaluated only when the total and every lap are valid times)
an entered coin change is an integer from -10 to +10
the running coin balance (race starts at 0; a lap without a change counts as 0) stays 0..10 after every lap; only the first lap that leaves the range is reported
an entered mushroom count is an integer from 0 to 3
the mushrooms of all laps add up to at most 3 (evaluated only when every entered count is 0..3)
an entered loadout id is at most 255 characters and has the schema-9 form of its kind (character., character_variant., body., body_variant., tire., glider., glider_variant.)
characterVariantId, bodyVariantId and gliderVariantId are only entered together with characterId, bodyId and gliderId

tt.rules.total_format.en: Enter the total time as six digits, for example 145912 for 1:45.912.
tt.rules.total_format.nl: Vul de totaaltijd in als zes cijfers, bijvoorbeeld 145912 voor 1:45.912.

tt.rules.total_seconds_range.en: Check the total time — seconds go up to 59.
tt.rules.total_seconds_range.nl: Controleer de totaaltijd — seconden gaan tot 59.

tt.rules.total_range.en: The total time must be at least 0:00.001.

tt.rules.lap_details_require_lap_times.en: Add the lap times to keep coins and mushrooms.
tt.rules.lap_details_require_lap_times.nl: Vul de rondetijden in om munten en paddenstoelen te bewaren.

tt.rules.lap_count_matches_track.en: This track has {expected} laps — you entered {actual}.
tt.rules.lap_count_matches_track.nl: Dit circuit heeft {expected} ronden — je hebt er {actual} ingevuld.

tt.rules.lap_missing.en: Lap {lap} missing — type it, or clear all laps.
tt.rules.lap_missing.nl: Ronde {lap} ontbreekt — vul hem in, of wis alle ronden.

tt.rules.lap_missing_suggested.en: Lap {lap} missing. From your total it would be {suggestionMs} — type it, or clear all laps.
tt.rules.lap_missing_suggested.nl: Ronde {lap} ontbreekt. Volgens je totaaltijd is dat {suggestionMs} — vul hem in, of wis alle ronden.

tt.rules.lap_time_format.nl: Vul ronde {lap} in als zes cijfers.

tt.rules.lap_seconds_range.en: Check lap {lap} — seconds go up to 59.

tt.rules.lap_sum_equals_total.en: Your laps add up to {lapSumMs}, the total is {totalMs}.
tt.rules.lap_sum_equals_total.nl: Je rondetijden tellen op tot {lapSumMs}, de totaaltijd is {totalMs}.

tt.rules.coin_change_range.en: Coins change by −10 to +10 per lap — lap {lap} has {change}.
tt.rules.coin_change_range.nl: Munten veranderen per ronde met −10 tot +10 — ronde {lap} heeft {change}.

tt.rules.coin_balance_below_zero.en: Coins can't go below 0 — lap {lap} would end at {balance}.
tt.rules.coin_balance_below_zero.nl: Munten kunnen niet onder 0 komen — ronde {lap} zou eindigen op {balance}.

tt.rules.coin_balance_above_ten.en: Coins can't go above 10 — lap {lap} would end at {balance}.
tt.rules.coin_balance_above_ten.nl: Munten kunnen niet boven 10 komen — ronde {lap} zou eindigen op {balance}.

tt.rules.mushrooms_race_total.en: Only 3 mushrooms in a race — you entered {total}.
tt.rules.mushrooms_race_total.nl: Maximaal 3 paddenstoelen in een race — je hebt er {total} ingevuld.

tt.rules.loadout_id_format.en: This part isn't in the catalogue — choose it again.
tt.rules.loadout_id_format.nl: Dit onderdeel staat niet in de catalogus — kies het opnieuw.

tt.rules.loadout_variant_requires_base.en: Choose the part before its colour variant.
tt.rules.loadout_variant_requires_base.nl: Kies eerst het onderdeel, daarna de kleurvariant.
